title: Kenyan Hash Browns with Wholesome Twist
description: A delicious twist on traditional hash browns, infused with wholesome ingredients and a touch of Kenyan spices. Perfect as a side dish or snack.
instructions: Grate the potatoes and squeeze out excess moisture.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chili powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the grated potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the hash and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and season with salt and pepper to taste.
